tools.name: find_stop
tools.description: Find Stockholm public transport (SL) stops by name and return their ids, names and transport modes. Use it to get the siteId for get_departures, or a stop id for plan_trip. tools.name: get_departures
tools.description: List live departures from one SL stop, soonest first: line, mode, final destination, direction (1 or 2), platform or bus stop letter, minutes or clock time, delay, cancellation and SL's notes. Use it for 'when does the next X leave from Y'. To get from A to B, use plan_trip; for announced track work

tools.name: get_disruptions
tools.description: List disruptions SL has announced: track work, closed entrances, broken lifts and replacement buses, with the lines affected and until when. Use it to check a line or the stops of a trip before travelling, e.g. lifts for a wheelchair. For live delays and cancelled departures, use get_departures inst

tools.name: plan_trip
tools.description: Plan trips by SL public transport between two stops or street addresses, leaving or arriving at a given time. Returns up to 3 trips, plus walking all the way when that takes at most 30 min. Each ride lists line, direction, platform, stops, crowding and delay; each walk lists minutes and the station
